# Refusals write no report and exit with status 2.
unhex $ROUNDTRIP/sm121a-roundtrip.cubin.hex k.cubin

# The symbol is required and must be exactly one code section.
! cudainspect report $WORK/k.cubin
! stdout .
stderr 'symbol is not exactly one code symbol'
! cudainspect report -symbol add $WORK/k.cubin
! stdout .
stderr '"add" matches 0 code sections'

# An image with no .text sections has no kernel to select.
mkelf cuda .data.kernel nocode.cubin
! cudainspect report -symbol kernel $WORK/nocode.cubin
! stdout .
stderr 'image has no code symbols'

# Neither text nor a non-CUDA ELF image is a CUBIN.
! cudainspect report -symbol kernel $WORK/notelf.cubin
! stdout .
stderr 'not a CUDA ELF image: ELF parse failed'
mkelf x86 .text.kernel x86.o
! cudainspect report -symbol kernel $WORK/x86.o
! stdout .
stderr 'not a CUDA ELF image: machine "EM_X86_64"'

# A CUDA image with an ELF version debug/elf cannot read is named as such.
mkelf cuda-v2 .text.kernel v2.cubin
! cudainspect report -symbol kernel $WORK/v2.cubin
! stdout .
stderr 'unsupported CUDA ELF version: EI_VERSION 1, e_version 2'

# An image over the bound is refused while it is read, before it is parsed.
! cudainspect report -symbol addk -max-bytes 100 $WORK/k.cubin
! stdout .
stderr 'input exceeds limit: .*k.cubin is over 100 bytes'

# A listing of other kernels does not describe the selection.
mkelf cuda .text.kernel kernel.cubin
! cudainspect report -symbol kernel -sass $ROUNDTRIP/sm121a-roundtrip.sass $WORK/kernel.cubin
! stdout .
stderr 'no instructions for function "kernel"'

# Flags are checked.
! cudainspect report -bogus $WORK/k.cubin
! stdout .
stderr 'flag provided but not defined'
! cudainspect inspect $WORK/k.cubin
stderr 'usage: cudainspect report'

-- notelf.cubin --
not an ELF image
